tasks.name_en: Open the single cabinet door to its declared open limit

instruction_variants: Open the single cabinet door to its declared open limit and verify that it stays there.
Keep hands and all loose objects outside the door sweep.
扉の可動域を空け、単扉を指定された開放位置まで開けて安定を確認してください。
tasks.notes: Directly patterned on RoboCasa atomic cabinet-opening tasks. The exact fixture model includes doorhinge range 0..1.57 rad, but Task Atlas runtime compatibility remains unknown. The source cabinet XML has no door-panel geom; use and review the full RoboCasa fixture composition. The raw cabinet XML is only an empty hinge anchor/outer shell; required door or storage geometry must come from a verified higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Close the single cabinet door to its seated limit
tasks.name_ja: 単扉キャビネットを着座する閉鎖位置まで閉める
instruction_variants: Close the cabinet door to its seated limit after verifying the swing path is clear.
Do not force the door against an obstructed shelf or hinge.
扉の可動域を確認し、キャビネットの扉を閉鎖位置まで戻してください。
tasks.notes: Directly patterned on RoboCasa atomic cabinet-closing tasks; this proposal measures only the fixture door state. The source cabinet XML has no door-panel geom; use and review the full RoboCasa fixture composition. The raw cabinet XML is only an empty hinge anchor/outer shell; required door or storage geometry must come from a verified higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Extend the drawer to the declared travel mark
tasks.name_ja: 引き出しを指定された移動目印まで引き出す
instruction_variants: Pull the drawer to its declared travel mark and stop without forcing the end stop.
Keep the drawer interior free of loose objects for this articulation-only task.
引き出しを指定された移動目印まで引き出し、無理に終端へ押し込まないでください。
tasks.notes: Directly patterned on RoboCasa atomic drawer-opening tasks. The extension mark is a collection target; the XML coordinate is not asserted as a real-world distance. The raw drawer XML omits the front and handle; a verified higher-level composition is required.

tasks.name_en: Return the extended drawer to its flush limit
tasks.name_ja: 引き出しを面一の閉鎖位置まで戻す
instruction_variants: Push the empty drawer to its flush limit without forcing an obstruction.
Keep hands and objects clear of the closing path.
空の引き出しを閉鎖経路の障害物に当てず、面一の閉鎖位置まで戻してください。
tasks.notes: Directly patterned on RoboCasa atomic drawer-closing tasks; no load handling is part of this task. The raw drawer XML omits the front and handle; a verified higher-level composition is required.

tasks.name_en: Store the empty bowl on the open cabinet shelf
tasks.name_ja: 空のボウルを開いたキャビネットの棚に収納する
instruction_variants: Place the empty bowl on the clear shelf inside the already open cabinet after confirming rim clearance and support.
Leave the cabinet door open when the bowl is stably supported.
空のボウルを、縁のクリアランスと棚の支持を確認してから開いたキャビネット内の空き棚へ置いてください。
tasks.notes: RoboCasa CounterToCabinet supports the kitchen transfer pattern. Bowl-specific rim/diameter and shelf fit are collection preflight conditions; fit and GSO compatibility remain unknown. The source cabinet XML has no door-panel geom; use and review the full RoboCasa fixture composition. The raw cabinet XML is only an empty hinge anchor/outer shell; required door or storage geometry must come from a verified higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Retrieve the plate from the open cabinet to the counter mat
tasks.name_ja: 開いたキャビネットから皿を取り出しカウンターマットに置く
instruction_variants: Retrieve the plate from the open cabinet and set it flat on the marked counter mat.
Keep the plate level and clear of the cabinet door sweep.
開いたキャビネットから皿を取り出し、水平を保って印付きカウンターマットに置いてください。
tasks.notes: RoboCasa CabinetToCounter supports this single-object transfer pattern. This differs from the existing rack/table plate tasks by its exact open-cabinet source and marked counter target. The source cabinet XML has no door-panel geom; use and review the full RoboCasa fixture composition. The raw cabinet XML is only an empty hinge anchor/outer shell; required door or storage geometry must come from a verified higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Store the dry spatula in the open drawer
tasks.name_ja: 乾いたスパチュラを開いた引き出しに収納する
instruction_variants: Place the clean, dry spatula inside the extended drawer after checking head and handle clearance.
Leave the drawer extended; do not close it as part of this task.
乾いて清潔なスパチュラをヘッドと柄の隙間を確認して引き出し内に置いてください。引き出しは開いたままにします。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas transfer extension using the pinned drawer fixture; the cited RoboCasa atomic evidence covers opening/closing and counter/cabinet transfer patterns, not this drawer pick-and-place. Clean/dry state and model fit are explicit conditions; compatibility remains unknown. The raw drawer XML omits the front and handle; a verified higher-level composition is required.

tasks.name_en: Retrieve the screwdriver from the open drawer to a tip-away mat
tasks.name_ja: 開いた引き出しからドライバーを取り出し先端を遠ざけてマットに置く
instruction_variants: Retrieve the screwdriver from the extended drawer and place it on the counter mat with its tip directed away from the operator.
Do not fasten, pry, or use the tool.
引き出しからドライバーを取り出し、先端を作業者から遠ざけてカウンターマットに置いてください。工具は使用しません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas transfer extension using the pinned drawer fixture; the cited RoboCasa atomic evidence covers drawer opening/closing but not this drawer pick-and-place. This is retrieval and staging only; no fastening task is implied. The raw drawer XML omits the front and handle; a verified higher-level composition is required.

tasks.name_en: Store the upright package proxy on the open cabinet shelf
tasks.name_ja: パッケージ形状proxyを直立させて開いたキャビネット棚に収納する
instruction_variants: Place the empty package proxy upright on the clear cabinet shelf after checking shelf height and depth.
Do not infer contents, shelf-life, or food storage suitability.
空のパッケージ形状proxyを棚の高さと奥行きを確認してから直立させて収納してください。内容物や食品保存適性は扱いません。
tasks.notes: RoboCasa CounterToCabinet is the kitchen transfer pattern. The package-specific task is distinct from the existing bowl and plate transfers: vertical clearance, upright stability, and depth are explicit; contents and storage suitability are out of scope. The source cabinet XML has no door-panel geom; use and review the full RoboCasa fixture composition. The raw cabinet XML is only an empty hinge anchor/outer shell; required door or storage geometry must come from a verified higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Rotate the hammer on the counter mat until its head points to the marked arrow
tasks.name_ja: ハンマーをカウンターマット上で回し打撃部を印の矢印へ向ける
instruction_variants: Rotate the hammer in place on the marked counter mat until its head points toward the target arrow.
Keep the hammer supported on the same mat; do not strike or test the tool.
ハンマーを同じマット上で回転し、頭部を目標矢印へ向けてください。打撃や工具性能の確認はしません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas orientation proposal only. It differs from hammer caddy-to-workbench transfer by retaining the same counter mat and making the head-to-arrow orientation the sole state change. The raw counter XML uses placeholder geometry; verify the higher-level dimensions and pose.

tasks.name_en: Stage the upright package proxy in a marked counter back row
tasks.name_ja: パッケージ形状proxyをカウンター奥列の印に直立配置する
instruction_variants: Move the empty package proxy from the front staging pad to the marked back-row slot, keeping it upright and facing the reference edge.
Do not infer product contents or retail display policy.
空のパッケージ形状proxyを手前の仮置きから奥列の印へ移し、直立と前面の向きを揃えてください。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas counter back-row staging proposal. RoboCasa fixture identity establishes only the counter model path; it does not establish this task pattern. The package back-row pose is distinct from the cabinet-storage task. The raw counter XML uses placeholder geometry; verify the higher-level dimensions and pose.

tasks.name_en: Rotate the screwdriver in place from tip-toward to tip-away
tasks.name_ja: ドライバーの先端を手前向きから遠方向きへマット上で回転する
instruction_variants: Keep the screwdriver on the same marked mat and rotate it so the tip points away from the operator zone.
Do not translate it off the mat or use it to fasten or pry.
ドライバーを同じマット上に保って回転し、先端を作業者側から遠ざけてください。ねじ締めやこじ開けはしません。
tasks.notes: This is orientation-only, unlike task 8 which moves a screwdriver from the drawer to the counter. The GSO asset is not a verified grasp-ready model. The raw counter XML uses placeholder geometry; verify the higher-level dimensions and pose.

tasks.name_en: Record the switch paddle's apparent pose without contact
tasks.name_ja: 接触せず照明スイッチのパドルの見かけの姿勢を記録する
instruction_variants: From the fixed camera pose, record whether the visible paddle appears lower, upper, or unresolved; save visibility and occlusion labels.
Do not touch the fixture or infer power state.
固定カメラ視点からパドルの見かけが下・上・判定不能のどれかを、可視性と遮蔽情報とともに記録してください。接触せず、通電状態を推定しないでください。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas visual-data proposal; no physical switch actuation is derived from the source model.

tasks.name_en: Record outlet face opening visibility from a fixed view
tasks.name_ja: 固定視点からコンセント面の開口の見え方を記録する
instruction_variants: Record whether the model's visible face openings are visible, partly occluded, or unresolved from the fixed view, and note occluded regions.
Do not touch, insert anything, or infer electrical safety or power.
固定視点から開口の見え方を可視・一部遮蔽・判定不能として記録し、遮蔽箇所も記録してください。接触や挿入をせず、電気的な安全性や通電は推定しません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas noncontact visual-inspection proposal; RoboCasa source-model collision/interaction limitations make this model unsuitable as a contact-task claim.

tasks.name_en: Record the counter work-zone bounds from calibrated RGB-D
tasks.name_ja: 校正済みRGB-Dでカウンター作業域の境界を記録する
instruction_variants: Use calibrated RGB-D in the declared sensor frame to estimate and save the marked counter work-zone bounds, sensor frame, calibration ID, and occluded regions.
Do not treat the estimate as collision clearance or ground-truth fixture dimensions.
校正済みRGB-Dから印付き作業域の境界を推定し、センサ座標系・校正ID・遮蔽箇所とともに保存してください。安全距離やfixtureの真値とは扱いません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas calibrated-measurement proposal. RoboCasa counter identity does not provide metrology ground truth. The raw counter XML uses placeholder geometry; verify the higher-level dimensions and pose.

tasks.name_en: Record counter top height relative to its marked reference plane
tasks.name_ja: 印付き基準面に対するカウンター天板高を記録する
instruction_variants: Measure the counter top relative to the declared reference plane and save the reference edge, sensor frame, calibration ID, units, and uncertainty.
Do not present the reading as absolute installation height or robot clearance.
定義済み基準面に対する天板高を測定し、基準縁・センサ座標系・校正ID・単位・不確かさとともに保存してください。絶対的な設置高やロボットのクリアランスとは扱いません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas metrology proposal; all numeric geometry remains unmeasured until a collection is performed. The raw counter XML uses placeholder geometry; verify the higher-level dimensions and pose.

tasks.name_en: Record the visible counter opening width between named edge points
tasks.name_ja: カウンター開口の指定した両縁間の幅を記録する
instruction_variants: Measure the distance between the two named visible opening-edge points and save units, frame, calibration, pose, and missing-depth flags.
This width is not a 3D object-fit result.
指定した二つの開口縁点の距離を測定し、単位・座標系・校正ID・視点・深度欠損flagとともに保存してください。この幅だけで物体の通過適合性を判断しません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas measurement proposal; a width record alone cannot establish passage feasibility. The raw counter_with_opening XML does not contain the aperture; opening geometry exists only after higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Record the visible path and occluded regions through the counter opening
tasks.name_ja: カウンター開口から見える経路と遮蔽領域を記録する
instruction_variants: Record which parts of the opening path and receiver region are visible from the declared view, and annotate occluded regions.
Do not infer hidden clearance, 3D passage, or object fit.
指定視点から開口経路と受け皿領域のどの部分が見えるか、遮蔽箇所とともに記録してください。隠れたクリアランスや物体適合は推定しません。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas visual-data proposal. This observation does not establish 3D compatibility and does not replace opening-transfer preflight. The raw counter_with_opening XML does not contain the aperture; opening geometry exists only after higher-level composition.

tasks.name_en: Transfer the bowl through the counter opening to a lower receiver
tasks.name_ja: ボウルをカウンター開口から下側の受け台へ移す
instruction_variants: After full 3D fit and collision preflight, move the bowl through the opening and release it stably in the lower receiver.
Stop if any edge, drop path, or support clearance is uncertain.
三次元形状と衝突の事前確認に合格した場合のみ、ボウルを開口から下側受け台へ通し、安定して置いてください。隙間が不明なら中止します。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas proposal only. Opening width and visible-path observations do not prove fit. Asset compatibility and robot execution remain unknown.

tasks.name_en: Retrieve the bowl through the counter opening from the lower receiver
tasks.name_ja: 下側の受け台からカウンター開口を通してボウルを取り出す
instruction_variants: After verifying lower approach, grasp, edge, and upper-target clearance, lift the bowl from the receiver through the opening to the marked counter target.
Do not continue if the bowl or gripper cannot clear the opening.
下側からの接近・把持・縁のクリアランス・上側の置き場を確認した後、受け台から開口を通してボウルをカウンターの印へ取り出してください。
tasks.notes: Task Atlas proposal only. This is a distinct lower-side grasp-and-lift transition from task 19's upper-side transfer and release.

draft_notes: Round 2 adds six exact fixture model paths from RoboCasa commit 4f8a2980def75a55dff96b990745b83540425f09 and twenty task proposals.

RoboCasa README gives project-level license terms (code MIT; assets/datasets CC BY 4.0) without classifying each XML file or referenced resource. The bundle records repository-tracked XML paths and does not copy meshes.

The cabinet_single model defines doorhinge with range 0..1.57 rad; drawer defines slidejoint with range -1.0..0. These are source-model coordinates, not measured physical travel or a tested Task Atlas runtime.

Counter fixtures are composable components, not ready-to-run scenes. Cabinet and drawer XML reference textures requiring asset setup. Switch and outlet are restricted to noncontact visual tasks because the source model has incomplete collision/interaction setup.

The two counter-opening transfer proposals require full 3D geometry, object-envelope, receiver, gravity, collision, and approach/release preflight. Width and visible path records are never treated as fit certificates.

RoboCasa pattern evidence is limited to cabinet/drawer opening and closing and single-item kitchen counter/cabinet transfers. Orientation, visual observation, metrology, and opening passage proposals cite the Task Atlas design seed only.
Existing user draft data/drafts/reference_robocasa_round2.json is intentionally not changed or loaded by this batch. It remains a separate draft with its own YCB chips-can counter/cabinet tasks.
GSO portable models used by some tasks retain their static-mesh and unverified-movability limits from reference_gso_round1.

Raw cabinet_single.xml contains an empty doorhinge anchor and outer-shell box geoms but no door panel, handle, shelf, or door-panel collision geometry; cabinet tasks require a verified RoboCasa wrapper composition.
Raw drawer.xml contains an inner-box and slidejoint but no front or handle; contact tasks require a verified RoboCasa wrapper composition.
Raw counter XML dimensions/poses and counter_with_opening aperture are produced by higher-level configuration; opening tasks require recording and verifying that composed geometry.

2026-10-04 independent granularity review: 5 atomic and 15 compound tasks. Multiple authored goal predicates are retained and classified as compound; no additional outcomes were invented to satisfy a round quota.
